edits.text: for (const [name, width, height, theme, motion, language, assistantEnabled] of [

const cinematic =
        motion === 'no-preference' &&
        height > 600 &&
        (width > 680 || height > 700)
      if (cinematic) {
        assert.ok(metrics.runway.height <= Math.max(height * 2, 1536),
          `${name}: excessive scroll runway`)
        assert.ok(metrics.controls.y + metrics.controls.height <= height,
          `${name}: navigation below the fold`)
